 Order
% 22.03.2023 Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.282/2019 registered at PS Sonia Vihar under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that parties have settled their issues with the facilitation of the Counseling Cell, Karkardooma Courts on 30th July, 2022, the settlement deed being on record of this Court.

As per the settlement, final balance amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is to be paid to respondent No.2 which is being tendered vide DD No.020686 dated 10.10.2022 drawn on HDFC Bank, to respondent No.2 who has duly received and acknowledged the same.
Petitioner Nos.1-4 and respondent No.2 are present in Court and duly identified by their counsels and the IO.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married and their marriage has been dissolved vide decree dated 30th November, 2022.
No child was born out of their wedlock.
Respondent No.2 states that she has received the amounts as per the settlement and she has no objection to the quashing of the said FIR.

2. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, FIR No.282/2019 registered at PS Sonia Vihar under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
